description.zh: 今天的农历日期、干支与生肖，加上下一个节气和一个节日还有几天
description.en: Today's lunar date, the sexagenary year, and how far the next solar term and festival are

items.zh: 最上面一行是公历日期和星期，大字是农历的月与日。
items.en: The top line is the Gregorian date and weekday; the large text is the lunar month and day.

items.zh: 大字下面那行是干支年与生肖，例如「丙午马年」。
items.en: Under it sits the sexagenary year and the animal, for example Bingwu year · Horse.

items.zh: 最下面两行分别是下一个节气和下一个节日，各差多少天。
items.en: The bottom two rows are the next solar term and the next festival, each with how many days away.

title.en: Where the lunar date comes from

items.zh: 用的是浏览器自带的 ICU 中国历法，不是一张抄来的万年历表。
items.en: It uses the ICU Chinese calendar built into the browser, not a copied lookup table.

items.zh: 所以闰月、大小月都由历法本身决定，包里没有一份会过期的数据。
items.en: So leap months and 29/30-day months come from the calendar itself; the package carries no data that can go stale.

items.zh: 用的是「你这一天」：按本机时区算，和墙上的钟对得上。
items.en: It uses your day, in the machine's own time zone, so it matches the clock on the wall.

items.zh: 太阳黄经每走 15° 就是一个节气，这里真的按天文位置算，不查表。
items.en: A solar term is where the sun's longitude crosses a multiple of 15°; this card computes it, it does not look it up.

items.zh: 所以任何年份都能算，不会因为表只到某一年就停。
items.en: So any year works; it does not stop at the last year of a table.

items.zh: 用的是低精度公式，误差约 15 分钟；节气贴着午夜的那一年可能和日历差一天。
items.en: The formula is low-precision, about 15 minutes of error; in a year where a term lands near midnight it can differ from a printed calendar by a day.

items.zh: 七个法定节日：元旦、春节、清明、劳动节、端午、中秋、国庆。
items.en: Seven public holidays: New Year's Day, Spring Festival, Qingming, Labour Day, Dragon Boat, Mid-Autumn, National Day.

items.zh: 清明直接用算出来的节气日期 —— 它每年在 4 月 4 日到 6 日之间晃。
items.en: Qingming uses the computed term date, because it moves between April 4 and 6 each year.

items.zh: 春节、端午、中秋的农历日期由历法反查，不用你填。
items.en: The lunar dates of Spring Festival, Dragon Boat and Mid-Autumn are looked up backwards, not filled in by hand.

items.zh: 每分钟看一次，但只有跨过午夜才重画 —— 这一页的粒度是「天」。
items.en: It looks once a minute but only redraws when the date changes; this card is measured in days.

items.zh: 窗口藏起来时心跳停摆，回来补一拍；不会因为藏过就停在昨天。
items.en: The heartbeat pauses while the window is hidden and catches up when it returns, so it never sticks on yesterday.

items.zh: 优先用平台的时钟（「时钟」权限）；拒绝这项权限时退回本机时钟，日期照样对。
items.en: It prefers the platform clock (the clock permission); without it the card falls back to the machine clock, which is usually the same.

items.zh: 运行时的 ICU 若没有中国历法，大字会写「农历不可用」，其余照常。
items.en: If the runtime's ICU has no Chinese calendar, the large text says No Chinese calendar and the rest still works.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：农历月日、干支生肖、下一个节气、下一个法定节日。
changes.en: First release: lunar month and day, sexagenary year and animal, the next solar term and the next public holiday.

changes.zh: 节气按太阳黄经现算（任意年份可用），农历走运行时自带的 ICU 中国历法。
changes.en: Solar terms are computed from the sun's longitude (any year works); the lunar date comes from the runtime's built-in ICU Chinese calendar.
